name: xcutai
description: Viral content research and writing for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Meta ads: trends, outlier posts, transcripts, hooks, scripts, captions and content plans.

interface.longDescription: XCut AI helps creators, brands and marketers make social media content that performs. It researches what is working on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and in the Meta Ad Library, then writes content from it. Ask what is trending in a niche, which of a creator's or competitor's posts beat their normal and by how much, and how an account is performing. Paste any post or video link to get its transcript and a breakdown of its hook, structure and call to action. Then get content ideas, hooks, Reels, TikTok, Shorts and YouTube scripts, captions, bios, titles, Meta ad copy and week or month content plans, written in your saved brand voice and put on your content calendar. Hooks, playbooks and quick tools work without an account. Imports, analytics and writing for your brand use your XCut AI account and credits. For accounts you connect to XCut AI, it also reads your own measured numbers (audience, best times, how each post did against your usual, Meta ad results) and prepares posts, schedules and ads that run only after you confirm inside XCut AI. Limitations: research covers publicly available posts, profiles and ads, imported through official platform APIs and licensed data providers. It never posts or spends on its own. This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
defaultPrompt: What's going viral on TikTok in my niche this week?
Which of a competitor's last 30 Instagram reels were outliers?
Give me 10 hooks and a caption for a video about pricing mistakes.

positive.prompt: Give me 10 hooks for a reel about pricing mistakes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 10 hook lines from XCut AI's hook library, adapted to a reel about pricing mistakes.

positive.description: What is trending in a niche
positive.prompt: What's going viral on TikTok for skincare this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of TikTok posts about skincare with views, engagement and links to each post.

positive.prompt: Which of @nike's last 20 Instagram posts were outliers?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the posts that beat the account's median performance and says by how much each beat it. If the analysis takes longer, it checks the job and then returns the list.

positive.description: Transcript and hook breakdown of a video
positive.prompt: Get the transcript of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw and tell me why the opening works.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the video's transcript and explains its opening hook, structure and ending.

positive.description: Script in the saved brand voice
positive.prompt: Write a 30-second TikTok script about pricing mistakes in my brand voice.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a TikTok script with a hook, body and call to action that follows the brand voice saved in the account.

positive.description: Saving a caption to the content calendar
positive.prompt: Put this caption on my calendar for Friday: 'New drop Friday'.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the caption as a calendar post for Friday. It does not claim to post it: XCut AI does not post to social media.

negative.description: Off-topic request: XCut AI is only for social media and marketing content, so it should not be called; the assistant answers without it.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Private content: XCut AI works only with publicly available posts, profiles and ads. Expected: no import, and an explanation that private messages cannot be accessed.
negative.prompt: Show me the private DMs of @nike.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0. Five new skills: analyze-post (a full breakdown of one post), creator-report (a creator's top posts against their usual, with charts), watchlist-insights (top videos, topics, formats and hooks across the accounts you track), find-creators (creators worth studying in a niche) and my-results (how your own posts did). Twelve bundled skills. Since 1.2.0: Your own accounts: connect Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook or a Meta ad account, see audience, best posting times and follower growth, how each post did against your usual, and Meta ad results with what to change. Posting, scheduling and ads stay under your control: the assistant hands you a link and nothing runs until you confirm inside XCut AI. Since 1.1.0: Social media content research and writing: viral post search across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and the Meta Ad Library; outlier and analytics reports for public profiles; post, profile, website and ad imports with transcripts; hooks, scripts, captions and content plans in the user's brand voice; content calendar drafts. Seven bundled skills.
